title: Scout candidate (candidates.jsonl board record)
description: One hunting candidate as a scout returns it, and as the orchestrator appends it to the candidates board (candidates.jsonl): the candidate object plus the board fields id and unit. A candidate is an observation with a trace, never a verdict. Read by scout prompts, the workflow graph, and validate_findings.py (board accounting).

id.description: Board id, minted by the orchestrator (<unit>-c<N>); unique within the run's board.

unit.description: The coverage unit id (<surface>::<boundary>) the scout was assigned.

path.description: Repo-relative file path of the primary location.

symbol.description: Enclosing symbol: '<router> <METHOD> <path>' for HTTP handlers, '<Class>.<method>' for methods, the function name otherwise.

code_context.description: The decisive snippet; evidence, never identity.

threat_class.description: Class id from threat-classes.md, e.g. INJ.

cwe.description: CWE anchor for the threat class.

root_cause_slug.description: 2-5 lowercase hyphen-separated words naming the root cause (fingerprint tail), e.g. sql-concat-in-search.

analysis.description: Why this violates the invariant; the verifier's starting point.

exploit_scenario.description: How attacker-controlled input reaches the effect.

entry_points.description: Entry points that reach the root cause, e.g. GET /users.

trace_paths.description: Repo-relative paths of the full source-to-sink trace; trace-changed watches these.

severity_guess.description: Provisional severity from the scout; drives verifier ordering and the second-verifier rule. Never a final severity.
